scholarship_title: Rhodes Scholarship for West Africa 2027 (with the Oxford-Morland-West Africa Graduate Scholarship)
eligible_nationalities: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

stipend.notes: GBP 20,400 a year (GBP 1,700 a month) at the 2025-26 rate; scholars pay accommodation from this. At least two years of study are covered; a DPhil can be funded for up to three years.

additional_benefits: Two economy return flights (start and end of studies)
Travel and accommodation for in-person final interviews within West Africa

application_fee.notes: No fee to apply for the Rhodes Scholarship; the Oxford course application fee is covered for selected scholars.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Completed undergraduate degree by the deadline with First Class Honours or equivalent (referee guidance mentions GPA of at least 3.70/4.00). Medicine, dentistry, pharmacy: highest classification plus distinctions in at least two of five main subjects.
language_proficiency: University of Oxford higher-level English requirement (test such as IELTS, or a waiver letter if eligible)
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: 18-24 on 1 Oct 2026; 18-25 for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, law and engineering; under 27 if the first degree was completed on or after 1 Oct 2025

country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is in the West Africa constituency, which has 3 scholarships a year. You must have lived in the region for at least five of the last ten years. Final interviews are held in person in Abuja, Accra or Lagos in November. Having studied to master's level at home is not counted as an advantage for applicants who studied in Nigeria or Ghana.

required_documents.name: Two identity documents
required_documents.detail: Any two of: certified birth certificate or affidavit of birth, national ID card, passport, voter's card, notarised citizenship affidavit

required_documents.name: Official university transcript
required_documents.detail: Grades to date; English translation if needed

required_documents.name: Proof of residence
required_documents.detail: At least five of the last ten years in the region, e.g. school records

required_documents.name: English test results or waiver request letter
CV section of the online form
required_documents.detail: Up to 5 entries per area; a separate CV file cannot be uploaded

required_documents.name: Personal statement
required_documents.detail: Up to 1,000 words, answering three guiding questions

required_documents.name: Academic statement of study
required_documents.detail: Up to 450 words, covering two years of study at Oxford

required_documents.name: Four to six references
required_documents.detail: At least three academic and at least one character referee; due 23:59 GMT 3 Sep 2026

preparation_alerts: Register referees early: references were due one week after the application deadline
Get an Oxford-accepted English test (e.g. IELTS) unless you qualify for a waiver
Finalists must attend interviews in person in Abuja, Accra or Lagos in November
You can only apply twice in total, in the same constituency

criteria.notes: Shown by transcript, academic statement and academic references

criteria.criterion: Energy to use your talents to the full
Truth, courage, devotion to duty, sympathy for and protection of the weak, kindliness, unselfishness and fellowship
Moral force of character and instincts to lead

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Longlist of up to 70, virtual interviews to a shortlist of up to 35, then no more than 15 finalists interviewed in person; scholarship confirmed only on admission to Oxford

verification_status.verification_notes: Read the full 2027 West Africa candidate document. The 2027 round (for entry Oct 2027) closed 27 Aug 2026; final interviews are in November 2026. The Rhodes site says applications are expected to reopen in 2027 for 2028 entry, without a date. Stipend shown is the 2025-26 rate from the main Rhodes page. The PDF says outcomes are emailed 'by December 2025', which looks like a typo for 2026.
